items.title: Decide whether to object (Widerspruch) to the hazard classification

date.text: Den Widerspruch können Sie binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Musterbau-Berufsgenossenschaft, Gerüstweg 7, 30159 Musterhannover.

items.quote: Den Widerspruch können Sie binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Musterbau-Berufsgenossenschaft, Gerüstweg 7, 30159 Musterhannover.
items.action: If you disagree with the new hazard classification (Gefahrklassen) for your business, you may file a written objection (Widerspruch) with the Berufsgenossenschaft, or declare it to the record there; the app shows the deadline.
items.consequence: If you do not object in time, the classification becomes final and binding for calculating your future contributions.

items.quote: Ihr Malerbetrieb wird ab dem 01.01.2027 nach unserem neuen Gefahrtarif veranlagt.

data.tax_note: Contributions to the statutory accident insurance (Berufsgenossenschaft) are deductible business expenses, so the hazard class that determines them is relevant for your business tax records.
data.title: New hazard classification (Gefahrklassen) for your painting business from 2027
data.summary: The Musterbau-Berufsgenossenschaft informs Bastian Musterquell that, from 1 January 2027, his painting business will be classified under hazard class 7.4 for the painting trade and 0.6 for office staff under its new hazard tariff (Gefahrtarif). An objection (Widerspruch) can be filed within one month of notification.
data.explanation: This is a decision (Bescheid) from your statutory accident insurance carrier (Berufsgenossenschaft) setting the "hazard classes" (Gefahrklassen) used to calculate your business's accident-insurance contributions from 2027: 7.4 for the painting trade and 0.6 for office work. No payment is due now — the actual contribution is calculated after the year ends from reported wages. If you think the classification is wrong, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or to the record at the Berufsgenossenschaft; the app shows the deadline. If you take no action, the classification becomes final. Consider consulting a tax or business advisor if you're unsure whether the classification fits your trade.
